answer: Proof of replication. Encode falcon tracking logs and juniper surveys into a full replica using each storage account's unique seed, then commit its root before audits begin. A verifier's audit thread requests unpredictable blocks under a deadline. N rewarded accounts must retain N distinct encodings, paying for disk capacity and maintenance; aliases alone add no storage. This assumes regeneration from a shared copy takes longer than the audit deadline. Fast recomputation or deduplication would break the bound.
